scope: Explicit ownership of off-thread decoded images during caller cancellation and independent wrapper cancellation

checks.advisories: unchanged dependency locks; prior zero-advisory receipt carried

cancellation_contract: Successful decode transfers usable PIL images to caller ownership.
Normal caller cancellation abandons outputs and drains the same shielded worker task, including repeated cancellation, before preserving the original cancellation.
Independent wrapper cancellation can finish before the thread; the worker-held locked owner closes any late output.
Worker errors during cancellation draining are consumed; route execution is never entered for cancelled decode.
limitations: Task completion does not prove an independently cancelled worker thread stopped.
PDF sync worker lifecycle, printer admission before preparation, disconnect shielding and whole-job spooling are separate remaining work.
No physical printer or provider call, foreign native acceptance or external promotion.

specialist.parent_audit: all delegated source and tests inspected; parent ran full backend suite and final static checks
